title: San Diego renews partnership with Caltrans to clear encampments
description:
Breaking through red tape + addressing unsafe encampments = success! Our agreement with Caltrans has been renewed for a second year to help people experiencing homelessness get off the streets and find help.  

Through this agreement, City crews can access Caltrans state property along freeways in the Downtown area to remove trash and waste. Since this effort began last year, more than 400 tons of waste has been removed. And, more importantly, 115 people have entered a sheltering program and 19 individuals have been housed.  

Caltrans is reimbursing the City up to $400,000 for maintenance along state right-of-way within this five-mile stretch of downtown. For more info, including how this year's crews can remove graffiti and brush in these areas, visit insidesandiego.org/city-san-diego-and-caltrans-mark-one-year-successful-partnership-and-renews-agreement-address
